observation: The matching stratified-placement ground capture has markedly fewer long exposed grass gaps than the root-contact-only view, while some bare patches remain. Residual brown soil banding is still visible; no complete visual fix is claimed.
method: Decode source RGB from sRGB to linear, compute Rec.709 luminance, average along each image axis, and measure standard deviation/mean plus the largest Fourier amplitude among cycles 1 through 31 per tile. Values rounded to four decimal places.
cause_assessment: Source luminance statistics document directional photo content but do not identify the sole cause of rendered bands. Higher-sample stochastic sampling and omission of the fine sward-derived vertex Dirt contribution did not remove the residual bands. Grass strips remain a separate unresolved observation; no cause is asserted proven.

correction.ordinary_layers: Retain two photographic color scales with near normal/roughness detail.

forest.far_sampling: One rotated retained photograph with matching explicit gradients.

vertex_soil_change.change: Remove the small MeadowSwardDensity contribution from vertex Dirt; retain broad soil variation and local building/deposit patches. Grass placement retains its existing fine occupancy field.
vertex_soil_change.scope: Avoids mixing the thresholded 7.8 m sward field into the coarser terrain-color lattice; does not establish that this field caused all visible bands.

grass_root_contact.method: Sample a 3-by-3 grid across the authored root plane and raise each clump only by measured terrain penetration. Reconstruct aligned proxy transforms from the corrected source.

diagnostic_findings.result: Residual broad banding remains; not a verified visual fix.

diagnostic_findings.result: Native root support checks pass, but visible pale grass strips persist.
Did not establish removal of the strips; one-sided opaque-material caveat remains. Further diagnosis is ongoing.

rejected_stochastic_experiment.photograph_sampling: Blend three independently rotated and offset photo lookups over shared triangle-lattice vertices, with rotated explicit texture gradients and variance-preserving color blending.
rejected_stochastic_experiment.normal_and_roughness: Original near-surface detail fades with each layer transition.
rejected_stochastic_experiment.reason: Matched 12 m and 3 m lattice renders did not demonstrate a useful reduction of visible bands. Additional 6-transition/3-far samples were not justified; no measured GPU benefit or regression is asserted.

placement_change.scope: Candidate XY positions change. Equal candidate count does not imply identical post-mask accepted instances or proven elimination of visible strips.
placement_change.visual_finding: Long gaps are markedly reduced; some bare patches remain. This comparison does not establish whole-scene appearance or performance acceptance.
